title: Geosynthetics Test method for the determination of mass per unit area of geotextiles and geotextile-related products
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies a method for the determination of mass per unit area of geotextiles and geotextile-related products for identification purposes and for use in technical data sheets. 1.2 This test method is applicable to all geotextiles and geotextile-related products.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Geotextiles - Sampling and Preparation of Test Specimens(BI-LINGUAL)

clause_3_terminology: Geosynthetics Test method for the determination of mass per unit area of geotextiles and geotextile
Geosynthetics Test method for the determination of mass per unit area of geotextiles and geotextile-related products

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
